content: कालिन्द {%a.%} (-न्दी|{%f.%}) [कलिन्द-अण्] Connected with or coming from the mountain Kalinda or the river Yamunā. .{@-न्दी@} .²1 The river Yamunā; कालिन्द्याः पुलिनेषु केलिकुपिताम् <ls>Ve. 1. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 28</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 4. 13</ls>. .²2 A sort of vessel. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a wife of Kṛṣṇa (a daughter of Sūrya). .{@-न्दम्@} A water melon.
